questions.q: According to the kind coachman, what is one of the hardest things to do when there is a fire or flood?
choices: Get horses out of a stable
Find water to put it out
Wake up the people in the house
Keep the carriage dry
questions.evidence: it is one of the hardest things in the world to get horses out of a stable when there is either fire or flood

questions.q: Who did John say was coming to take James's place?
choices: Little Joe Green from the lodge
The gardener's son
Old Norman
A bigger boy from the village
questions.evidence: Little Joe Green at the lodge

questions.q: Why did James worry about Joe Green taking his place?
choices: He thought Joe was too small and young to be much use
He thought Joe was lazy
He thought Joe was unkind to horses
He wanted the job for his brother
questions.evidence: it will be six months before he can be of much use

questions.q: How long did John agree to try Joe Green before deciding?
choices: Six weeks
Six months
Two weeks
One year
questions.evidence: I was quite agreeable to try him for six weeks

questions.q: What happened to John when he was about Joe's age?
choices: His parents died of fever and left him with his sister Nelly
He ran away to London
He won a horse race
He was sent to the workhouse
questions.evidence: my father and mother died of the fever within ten days of each other

questions.q: How did the mistress help John's sister Nelly?
choices: She hired a room for her and gave her work and food
She sent her to a school in town
She took her to live in the big house
She found her a job as a cook
questions.evidence: She went and hired a room for her with old Widow Mallet

questions.q: John calls the saying "take care of number one" selfish. In this saying, what does "number one" mean?
choices: Yourself
The best horse
The master
The first job of the day
questions.evidence: Everybody look after himself, and take care of number one

questions.q: What is the main lesson John teaches James in this chapter?
choices: Do a kindness when you have the chance, because others were kind to you
Always work for the highest wages
Never trust a young boy with horses
Look after yourself first
questions.evidence: there's nothing like doing a kindness when 'tis put in your way

questions.q: Since Joe was too short to groom Ginger and Beauty, which horse did James teach him on?
choices: Merrylegs
Ginger
The doctor's horse
Captain

questions.q: How did Merrylegs act after James left?
choices: He missed James and stopped eating well for several days
He was glad James was gone
He kicked Joe Green
He ran away from the stable
questions.evidence: he pined after him for several days, and went quite off his appetite
